test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet along the lines. In the cube so formed, what would be the number on the face opposite to the one having 5?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dcfcaaf7dcb337250fd7d0ec4da0be6ccea6f0001e5a1f75ac2cfe9d3100a55.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c25495a3c813f17dbb3d3d148e80369a0b954d810852172fc92ed61c0bd8fae5.png] 

The opposite sides are:

1 → 6

2 → 5

4 → 3

Clearly, 5 is opposite to 2.

Hence, the correct answer is "2".
